param_input_item.param_description: a uint8 vector of 32 bytes or 64 hexadecimal characters: secret key.
a uint8 vector of 24 bytes or 48 hexadecimal characters: unique per message for a given key (use crypto.random).
a uint8 vector or hexadecimal text: the 16-byte authentication tag followed by the ciphertext, as produced by crypto.aead.encrypt.
a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): the same associated data passed to encrypt.

param_output_item.param_description: a uint8 row vector: the decrypted bytes.

description.p: crypto.aead.decrypt verifies the authentication tag and returns the plaintext of a message produced by crypto.aead.encrypt.
It raises Nelson:core:aeadAuthenticationFailed when the key, nonce, associated data or encrypted message has been altered; never use unauthenticated data.
